notes.learning: From 'ìmọ̀' (knowledge) + 'gbogbogbò' (general/universal). Refers to information accumulated over time across various subjects.

examples: Ìmọ̀ gbogbogbò ṣe pàtàkì fún ìdánwò. (General knowledge is important for examinations)
Ó ní ìmọ̀ gbogbogbò lórí ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ kókó. (He has general knowledge on many topics)
data.subject: General Knowledge
